summary.text: Vincent Hughes is a Democrat who represents Pennsylvania's 7th Senatorial District, which covers part of Montgomery County and part of Philadelphia, and is the Democratic (minority) chair of the Senate Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hughes first served as a State Representative before becoming a State Senator. His official biography says his colleagues elected him Democratic chairman of the Senate Appropriations Committee in 2010, and that education has been a top priority, including the PA Promise grant legislation, the Diverse Teacher Pipeline and Student Teacher Stipend programs, and the Read 2 Succeed literacy program.

The biography also credits him with legislation for automatic voter registration through PennDOT, notes his membership on Cheyney University's Council of Trustees, and describes a scholarship fund he and his family established in honor of his late father.
